title.en: SUPPLEMENTAL CONTRIBUTORY PENSIONS TRUST AMENDMENT ORDER 2024

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-11-2024-SUPPLEMENTAL-CONTRIBUTORY-PENSIONS-TRUST-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2024.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Trust (Amendment) Order, 2024 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 24th of section 21 of S 58/2009

21 of the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Trust Order, 2009 is fa) in subsection (1), by deleting "prescribed" from the last line and by substituting "next 20-year" therefor; {b) in subsection (3){b), by deleting "as specified in rules or regulations made under section 39" and by substituting the following therefor - with the following formula - A B-C A is the account balance at the time of the revision; years multiplied by 12 months; and Cis the total number of months the SCP benefit paid.". Made this 11th. day of Rejab, 1445 Hijriah corresponding to the 23rd. day of January, 2024 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, DARUSSALAM.
